item.title: Super Mario Bros Nintendo Switch: The Ultimate Guide to Every Game Worth Playing
item.description:
Super Mario Bros Nintendo Switch: The Ultimate Guide to Every Game Worth Playing

Did you know that the Super Mario franchise has sold over 800 million copies worldwide, making it the best-selling video game franchise in history? And yet, many Nintendo Switch owners have played fewer than half of the Mario titles available on the platform. If you own a Switch, you are sitting on one of the richest libraries of Super Mario Bros content ever assembled on a single console.

item.title: MSP Airport Spring Break Chaos: TSA Wait Times, Staff Pressure, and What Travelers Need to Know
item.description:
Spring break 2026 is hitting MSP Airport hard. With thousands of travelers flooding Minneapolis-Saint Paul International, TSA employees are under mounting pressure — yet security lines keep moving. Here’s everything you need to know before heading to the airport.

Key Takeaways

  • Spring break travelers are packing MSP Airport, driving significant volume increases
  • TSA employees face growing pressure amid federal workforce uncertainty, but lines keep moving
  • Current TSA wait times at MSP remain manageable despite the surge
  • MSP also making headlines in managed service provider (MSP) industry with major deals

MSP Airport Spring Break Rush — What’s Happening on the Ground

According to KARE 11, spring break travelers are packing MSP Airport as of March 2026. The annual surge has turned terminals into a sea of families, college students, and vacationers all competing for overhead bin space.

item.title: Stephen Moyer's Remarkable Career Revival: From True Blood to The Night Agent & The Forsytes
item.description:
Did you know Stephen Moyer just made history — twice in one month? The British actor, best known as Bill Compton from True Blood, is simultaneously making waves on two major platforms in early 2026, and the story behind it is genuinely remarkable for any fan of quality television.

Quick Summary

  • Stephen Moyer joins The Night Agent Season 3 as Peter Sutherland’s most dangerous adversary yet
  • His new PBS drama The Forsytes was renewed for Seasons 2 AND 3 before Season 1 even aired — a first in his 35-year career
  • The Forsytes premieres March 22, 2026 on PBS Masterpiece; all 6 episodes drop simultaneously on the PBS app
  • Moyer plays Jolyon Forsyte Sr., a wealthy Victorian-era stockbroker and family patriarch

Stephen Moyer in The Night Agent Season 3: A “Prodigious Adversary”

Netflix’s action thriller The Night Agent dropped its third season in early March 2026, and Stephen Moyer is one of its most talked-about new additions.

item.title: Trey Hendrickson Injury Update: How a Core Muscle Surgery Is Reshaping NFL Free Agency
item.description:
The most dominant pass rusher of the last three NFL seasons is sitting at home without a team, and a single surgery is the reason why.

Trey Hendrickson, the four-time Pro Bowl defensive end, entered 2026 free agency expecting a bidding war. Instead, he got silence, lowball offers, and a gap between his asking price and reality that could be as wide as $10 million per year. The culprit? A core muscle injury that cut his 2025 season to just seven games and forced him under the knife in December.
